evidence: app/package.json:9 — hono ^4.13.14, which is npm latest stable (4.13.14 released Oct 25 2026; v5 is only at rc.1, per github.com/honojs/hono/releases)
app/src/views.js:1 — `html` from hono/html, the current documented helper (hono.dev/docs/helpers/html, also confirmed in .agents/skills/hono/SKILL.md:586)
app/src/app.js:42 — serveStatic from @hono/node-server/serve-static, the current v4 path for the Node adapter
app/src/server.js:2 — `serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port })`, the current @hono/node-server ServeOptions API

app/src/views.js:90-95 — hx-get/hx-trigger 'input changed delay:200ms'/hx-target/hx-swap/hx-push-url, all current htmx 2.x attributes (htmx 2.0.11 is npm `latest`; htmx 4.0 was released 2026-08-28 but the team intentionally kept 2.x as latest)
app/public/app.js:4 — htmx:configRequest, a documented current htmx event
latest_apis.rationale: Every framework API in use is the current generation: newest stable Hono (4.13.14, five days old at review time), the documented hono/html helper, the current node-server adapter APIs, and htmx 2.0.11 which is still npm `latest`. No legacy-era patterns anywhere.

evidence: app/src/api.js:24 — native global fetch with res.json(), no HTTP client library
app/src/views.js:137-145 — URLSearchParams for pagination/filter URLs
app/src/api.js:58-70 — Promise.all + Array.from for concurrency instead of a p-limit dependency
app/public/styles.css:1-48 — CSS custom properties for all tokens; styles.css:89-92 — logical properties (margin-inline/padding-inline)
app/package.json:4 — "type": "module", ES modules throughout, no bundler needed
app/src/api.js:31-33 — idFromUrl hand-rolls URL parsing with a regex where new URL(url).pathname would be the platform primitive
platform.rationale: Reaches for the platform first almost everywhere (fetch, URLSearchParams, ES modules, logical CSS properties, Map/Set, padStart) with zero polyfills or hand-rolled platform substitutes, minus one regex-based URL parse.

evidence: app/package.json:8-10 — exactly three runtime deps: hono, @hono/node-server, htmx.org; no dev deps, no build tooling
app/public/htmx.min.js:1 — a vendored copy of htmx.min.js served statically, while grep shows no source file ever imports the htmx.org package
app/src/app.js:8 — build script is a no-op, so nothing copies htmx.org's dist file; the dependency and the vendored copy can silently drift apart
dependencies.rationale: Minimal and modern overall (two necessary Hono packages, no build chain), but htmx.org is dead weight: it's never imported and the served file is a stale-able vendored copy, so the lockfile pins a version nothing uses.

evidence: app/src/api.js:1-160 — all API access, caching, humanization and the global index live in one module; routes never fetch directly
app/src/views.js:4-9 vs app/src/app.js:35-47 — only four framework imports across the whole app, so a Hono upgrade touches very few lines
app/src/api.js:3 — API_BASE_URL read in exactly one place

app/src/views.js:181-186 — re-implements englishGenus/latestEnglishFlavor inline instead of importing the identical helpers exported at app/src/api.js:42-49, so a display-rule change must be made twice
app/src/app.js:41-43 — three hand-enumerated serveStatic routes with cwd-relative './public/...' paths; adding an asset needs a code edit and a different start directory breaks them
app/src/api.js:24 — res.json() flows into views completely untyped (0 typeLines, plain .mjs), so a PokeAPI shape change surfaces as a runtime rendering bug rather than a type error
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is properly centralized and framework surface area is tiny, so upgrades would ripple very little; deductions for the duplicated English-name/flavor helpers, brittle cwd-relative static serving, and no types at the API boundary.

findings.issue: htmx.min.js is vendored as a static copy while the htmx.org dependency (app/package.json:10) is never imported by anything; the two can drift in version with no build step to keep them in sync.
findings.suggestion: Pick one: either drop the htmx.org dependency and document the vendored file, or serve it straight from node_modules (e.g. serveStatic({ root: './node_modules/htmx.org/dist' })) so the lockfile governs what ships.

findings.issue: pokemonPage re-implements the English-genus lookup and the latest-English-flavor-text extraction inline, duplicating englishGenus and latestEnglishFlavor already exported from app/src/api.js:42-49.
findings.suggestion: Import and call englishGenus(species) and latestEnglishFlavor(species.flavor_text_entries) so the display rules live in one place.

findings.issue: Static assets are wired with three per-file serveStatic({ path: './public/...' }) middlewares whose paths resolve against the process cwd, not the module location; running npm start from a different directory 404s all assets, and every new asset needs a new route.
findings.suggestion: Use one mount — app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: './public' })) — anchored to import.meta.dirname, or at minimum compute the root from the module URL.

findings.issue: PokeAPI responses flow through res.json() into views with no types at all (0 typeLines, plain .mjs), so upstream data-shape changes fail at render time rather than at a boundary.
findings.suggestion: Add JSDoc or convert to TypeScript with declared interfaces for the API records at the api.js boundary; Hono's tooling story (typed routes, createFactory) is going unused too.

findings.issue: The response cache and the once-per-process index (app/src/api.js:71-73) have no size bound or invalidation hook; the spec permits it, but data refreshed upstream mid-deploy stays stale for the process lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for this fixed-snapshot app; if requirements move, add a TTL or an explicit invalidate() export rather than reaching into the Map.

findings.issue: onError returns the Not-found page markup with status 500, coupling the error path to the 404 view and showing users 'Not found' for genuine server errors.
findings.suggestion: Render a distinct error page (or c.text) from onError so failures aren't disguised as missing resources.

findings.issue: idFromUrl parses API URLs with a regex; URL is the platform primitive for this and would survive URL shape tweaks (query strings, no trailing slash) better.
findings.suggestion: const { pathname } = new URL(url); then match the trailing integer segment.

summary: A lean, no-build Hono 4 + htmx 2 app that is fully on the current stable generation of everything it touches: hono 4.13.14 (npm latest), the documented hono/html helper, current node-server adapter APIs, and htmx 2.0.11, with data access cleanly isolated in one API module so framework upgrades would touch few lines. The main forward-looking debt is hygiene rather than churn risk: an unused htmx.org dependency duplicating a vendored copy, re-implemented display helpers in views, and cwd-relative per-file static routes. Adding types at the API boundary would round it out, but the code is easy to own and cheap to upgrade as written.

apis.replacement: htmx 4.0 exists (Aug 2026) but the maintainers keep 2.x as npm latest; no change required
